plugins.name: clearbounce
plugins.description: Verify email addresses and clean email lists with live mailbox checks. Adds the ClearBounce MCP server (verify_email, verify_bulk, check_bulk_status, find_email, check_credits) plus skills for list cleaning and API integration.

skills.name: clearbounce-api
skills.description: Integrate ClearBounce email verification into code — signup forms, checkout flows, CRM syncs, batch jobs. Use when the user wants to call the ClearBounce REST API, needs the endpoint/response shapes, wants to test without spending credits (sandbox keys), or asks how to handle verification results in their app.

skills.name: email-verification
skills.description: Verify email addresses or clean an email list with ClearBounce. Use when the user asks whether an address is valid/deliverable, wants to clean, validate or de-bounce a list (CSV, spreadsheet, text), wants to find someone's business email, or asks about their ClearBounce credits.

commands.name: verify-list
commands.description: Clean an email list with ClearBounce — extract addresses from a file, verify them in bulk, and report which ones are safe to send to.
